seed_check: Committed n=12 rows in bench/gmin-panel use seeds 2000-2011 on every cell. Declared seeds are 2000-2023, that original twelve plus 2012-2023.
hit_rule: energy_hits: a hit is best <= reference + 0.001. A miss is stored at the budget.
arm_order_rule: Across seeds, slot 0 is anneal and slot 1 is gmin when seed-2000 is even, and the reverse when it is odd. That is ABBA repeated. Balance is the count of (slot, arm) pairs.
anneal_build: One release build of the base commit with rustc 1.88.0 and cargo --locked. Examples: h2h_gmin_proof, h2h_morse, h2h_metal. No second build and no table patch.
gmin_build: One build from the local pinned tarball through scripts/gmin_panel/build_gmin.sh --tarball. Revision 9cbec1a446352bc9ef064bd2b1a5767194655919. The three patches below are applied in order. ALIGN, MPI and OpenMP are off. Reference BLAS and LAPACK.
lj103: examples/h2h_gmin_proof.rs at the base maps lj103 to 103 atoms, reference -575.766131 and budget 4000000. The table patch is not applied. Both arms run on that entry. If the built binary rejects lj103, that cell is left unrun rather than patched.
retry: A failed attempt is repeated with the same command, at most three times. The error token is then stored and the session continues. A completed row is never rewritten.
machine_id: sha256 of the operating system machine id file bytes.

analysis.hits: hits per arm out of the stored rows, expected 24
analysis.mcnemar: exact two-sided binomial test on the discordant pairs
analysis.newcombe: paired method 10, 95 percent: Wilson intervals for the two marginal hit proportions, combined with the continuity-corrected phi coefficient
analysis.wilcoxon: two-sided signed rank of anneal wall minus gmin wall. Zero differences are dropped. Exact permutation when every remaining absolute difference is unique; otherwise the normal approximation with the tie correction and a continuity correction.
analysis.median_calls: Hyndman-Fan type 7 after a miss is ranked after every hit
analysis.median_wall_diff: Hyndman-Fan type 7 of anneal wall minus gmin wall, zeros kept
